question: For a patient started on phenytoin for new-onset epilepsy, a reliable TDM trough level to guide maintenance dosing can be drawn at 24 hours after the first oral dose.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct. Phenytoin steady state requires 5 half-lives — often 5–14 days of maintenance dosing. TDM levels drawn before steady state are unreliable for maintenance dose adjustment. The exception is suspected acute toxicity, where an immediate level detects overload.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Incorrect. Phenytoin has saturable (zero-order) kinetics and a half-life of 12–36 hours that extends unpredictably as doses increase. Steady state is reached only after approximately 5 half-lives — this may take 5–14 days. A level drawn at 24 hours reflects only the loading phase, not the maintainable equilibrium concentration, and will mislead dose adjustment.
